text:
noah_sales: Quick kickoff for MeridianPay POC — needs SSE streaming, tool/function calls for invoice parsing, strict JSON schema output, SAML + customer KMS, and a procurement-friendly monthly delta for reserved vs hosted. Can eng produce runnable samples in 48h?

anya_eng: Yes. We'll ship a compact Node SSE sample and a Python websocket fallback. Include a replay driver to hit ~700-1k QPS. Minimal SSE send: `emit('data',{prompt:'parse_invoice',stream:true})`.

lucy_se: For structured output we'll use function-calling with JSON Schema and show a validator returning structured 422 errors. Example success payload: `{"tool":"parse_invoice","args":{"vendor":"string","total":{"type":"number","currency":"USD"}}}`

anya_eng: Ops notes: recommend reserved pool for steady low tail-latency; batching window 15-25ms for cost/throughput tradeoff. Fallback route to lower-cost model with header `x-redwood-fallback: true`. Use ephemeral API tokens (TTL 15m). KMS: support AWS/GCP CMKs.

mike_ops: I'll spin up a demo sandbox and provision AWS CMK. Need samples by EOD to run perf.

rita_legal: Send security questionnaire to legal@redwood.ai. Upload link: https://onetrust.example.com/meridian-upload. They require SOC2, KMS key policy docs, and residency notes.

noah_sales: Procurement needs a quick ballpark. Any rough numbers?

anya_eng: Rough: reserved 4x A100 equiv for 1k QPS ~ "$31k/mo"; hosted autoscale with batching ~ "$19k/mo". I'll follow up with token assumptions.

lucy_se: Demo tip: show schema rejection -> client maps field errors to corrective prompts. Also show structured fallback result: `{"result":null,"errors":[{"code":"MISSING_FIELD","field":"total"}]}`.

noah_sales: Great. Timeline: collect sample prompts today, perf numbers tomorrow AM, demo Wed 2pm PT. I'll send invites and the deck.
